extensions.scope: Nila covers the Turu Monitor web surface only (bot/assets/monitor/index.html). The egui desktop/Android UI (frontend/src/gui/turu/theme.rs) keeps its Mugetsu palette and must not use these tokens.

nila-field.purpose: Top bar, roster sheets, side panel, dialogs.

nila-raise.purpose: Hover, current row, selected segment, floating bars, toasts.

nila-sunk.purpose: Inputs, segmented troughs, meters, the log.

indigo-rule.purpose: 1px borders on controls, sheets and the top bar.

indigo-rule-soft.purpose: Row dividers, list dividers, track backgrounds.

mori-ink-2.purpose: Secondary text, night summary, inactive tabs.

mori-ink-3.purpose: Captions, column heads, placeholders, offline marks.

soga.purpose: The only accent: primary actions, selection, focus, links.

soga-ink.purpose: Text and ticks on soga fills.

soga-soft.purpose: Picked rows, pressed toggles, update chip, focus halo.

jade.purpose: State dye: playing / healthy; HP; kills chart.

kunyit.purpose: State dye: degraded (paused, relogging, reconnecting); drops chart.

mengkudu.purpose: State dye: trouble; danger buttons; target HP.

mana-blue.purpose: Data only: MP bars and the XP chart. Never an interface accent.

title.purpose: The open bot's name in the side panel; the largest type.

body.purpose: Base text; names at 600, inline figures at 600.

label.purpose: Row state, band and group heads (650), totals, captions of charts, toasts.

caption.purpose: Column heads, cell sub-lines, timestamps, meter text, panel section heads (600). Axis drops to 11px.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Selection bar, toasts, dialogs, drawer-mode side panel only. Light theme: rgb(22 27 61 / .16).

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected segmented option; the only in-flow shadow.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Text input focus, with a soga border.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on controls and rows.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Bar and meter width (400ms), state ping (900ms), toast rise (250ms).

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The trace's now dot while a script runs.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables breathe, ping and bar transitions.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Night summary moves into the page; 12px page padding; band rows wrap.

breakpoints.name: dock
breakpoints.purpose: Side panel docks at 440px above; fixed drawer with scrim below.

breakpoints.name: roster-compact (container)
breakpoints.purpose: Map and gold/h columns fold away.

narrative.overview:
Checking on a sleeping bot is reading a length of indigo-dyed batik. The page is one deep nila field in three layers, written on in unbleached mori cream. Soga brown is the only accent, and it marks only what you act on or have selected. Three natural dyes carry state: jade for playing, kunyit yellow for degraded, mengkudu red for trouble. Each bot is a single row, and its last hour is drawn as a line of wax dots (the cecek trace).

The page is dense and calm. Rows show the whole bot at once, columns stay fixed so values change in place without reflowing, and trouble is ranked first in its own band. Depth comes from tonal layers and hairline indigo rules. Shadows are kept for things that float over the page. Type is the platform's own sans with tabular figures, so changing numbers stay steady.

The page is built for a short check-in on a phone or another PC, often at night. Everything has to read at a glance at 360px wide. A default dark card grid with a purple accent and a stat-tile header is the thing this world refuses.
keyCharacteristics: One indigo field in three tonal layers (ground, field, raise) plus a sunk well for inputs and logs.
Cream ink in three strengths; soga brown as the single accent, for actions and selection only.
State is told by dye colour plus a word, never colour alone.
Hairline 1px indigo rules divide everything; radii stay small (4 to 10px).
Fixed-column whole-row roster; the cecek trace is the signature.
Light theme remaps every role (follows the OS, or a stored choice), keeping the same structure.

rules.name: The One Mordant Rule
rules.body: Soga is the only accent, and it marks action or selection. It never colours state, decoration or headings.

rules.name: The Dye Means State Rule
rules.body: Jade, kunyit and mengkudu always mean playing, degraded and trouble. Never use them for decoration, and always pair them with a word or icon.

rules.name: The Mixed, Not Invented Rule
rules.body: Tints come from `color-mix()` over existing roles (danger border = mengkudu 40% into rule; hover border = ink 22% into rule; band fill = mengkudu 7% into field). Do not add new hex values for a tint.

rules.name: The Weight Before Size Rule
rules.body: The scale runs only from 11 to 18px. New emphasis comes from weight (500 / 550 / 600 / 650) and ink strength, not from a larger size.

rules.name: The Steady Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that update live (gold/h, kills, HP, run time) stay tabular and right-aligned in fixed-width columns.

rules.name: The Flat Cloth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces in the flow of the page have no shadow. If it scrolls with the roster, it gets depth from tone and a rule, not a shadow.

dos: **Do** keep Soga to action and selection: one filled primary per row or dialog, and everything else outlined or ghost.
**Do** pair every dye with a word: "Running" in jade with a jade dot, "Script error" in mengkudu with a mengkudu dot.
**Do** derive tints with `color-mix()` from the existing roles, and add each new token to both the dark and the light theme.
**Do** keep roster columns on fixed grid tracks so live values change in place.
**Do** use inline 16px stroke SVG icons (1.75 stroke, round caps) from the page's own symbol sprite.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`, keep touch targets at 40px on coarse pointers, and keep the page working at 360px wide with no external fetches.
**Do** blur private fields (names, gold, room numbers) under streamer mode with the `priv` hook.
donts: **Don't** apply Nila to the egui desktop/Android UI. It keeps its Mugetsu palette.
**Don't** introduce a purple or violet interface accent. The `#7C6CF0` in the Turu logo symbol is a brand asset and stays inside the logo; Mana Blue is for data only.
**Don't** build a stat-tile header or a grid of bot cards. Totals stay inline text, and bots stay whole rows.
**Don't** put shadows on in-flow surfaces (see The Flat Cloth Rule).
**Don't** use dye colours to decorate, or soga to signal state.
**Don't** add type above 18px or introduce a webfont for the dashboard.
